chunks: No: You will call to Him alone; and He will, if He please, remove (the distress) for which you had called Him; and forget those you associate as compeers (with Him)
ai.seo_question: What happens to idols when people call upon God in times of distress?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological phenomenon of *ghaflah* (heedlessness), where believers revert to shirk after their trials are lifted, forgetting the unity they acknowledged in distress. It underscores the necessity of maintaining constant *dhikr* to prevent the erosion of Tawhid once immediate needs are met. This reflects the scholarly view that true monotheism requires not just recognition in crisis, but steadfastness in ease.
